q1.explanationZh: shrug 可作动词和名词，“耸肩”；过去式 shrugged 要双写 g。

q2.explanationZh: shut“关上”，过去式、过去分词都是 shut。

q3.explanationZh: shuttle 指短程往返的班车或穿梭运送，shuttle bus“班车”。

q4.explanationZh: shy 形容词“害羞的”，a shy look“羞怯的表情”。

q5.explanationZh: sick 形容词“有病的；恶心的”，be sick of“厌烦”。

q6.explanationZh: sick 加 -ness 构成名词 sickness“疾病；恶心”。

q7.explanationZh: side 名词“旁边；侧面”，on either side of“在……的两边”。

q8.explanationZh: sidewalk 是美式英语“人行道”，由 side + walk 构成。

q9.explanationZh: sigh 名词、动词同形，“叹气”；注意 gh 不发音。

q10.explanationZh: sight 名词“视力；景象；看见”，at first sight“乍一看”。

q11.explanationZh: sightseeing 由 sight + seeing 构成，go sightseeing“去观光”。

q12.explanationZh: sign 名词“标志；手势”，动词“签名”；g 不发音。

q13.explanationZh: signal 名词“信号”，也可作动词“发信号”。

q14.explanationZh: signature 是 sign 的名词形式“签名”。

q15.explanationZh: significance 名词“重要性”，be of great significance“有重大意义”。

q16.explanationZh: significant 形容词“重要的；显著的”，名词是 significance。

q17.explanationZh: silence 名词“寂静；沉默”，形容词是 silent。

q18.explanationZh: silent 形容词“安静的”，keep silent“保持沉默”。

q19.explanationZh: silk 名词“丝；丝绸”，a silk scarf“一条丝巾”。

q20.explanationZh: silly 形容词“愚蠢的”，Don’t be silly.“别傻了。”

q21.explanationZh: silver 名词“银；银色”，solid silver“纯银”。

q22.explanationZh: similar 形容词“相似的”，be similar to“与……相似”。

q23.explanationZh: simple 形容词“简单的；朴素的”，副词是 simply。

q24.explanationZh: simple 的动词形式 simplify“简化”，注意 -ify 结尾。

q25.explanationZh: simple 去 e 加 y 构成副词 simply“简单地；简直”。

q26.explanationZh: since 表示“自从”，也可表示原因“既然”。

q27.explanationZh: sincere 形容词“真诚的”，副词是 sincerely。

q28.explanationZh: sincere 直接加 -ly 构成副词 sincerely，保留 e。

q29.explanationZh: sing“唱歌”，过去式 sang，过去分词 sung。

q30.explanationZh: sing 加 -er 构成名词 singer“歌手”。

q31.explanationZh: single 形容词“单个的；单身的”。

q32.explanationZh: sink 动词“下沉；使下沉”，名词“水槽”；过去式 sank。

q33.explanationZh: sir“先生”，书信开头常用 Dear Sir。

q34.explanationZh: shy“害羞的”修饰 look（表情），a shy look“羞怯的表情”。

q35.explanationZh: silk 作定语表示材料，a silk scarf“一条丝巾”。

q36.explanationZh: “思乡病”英语中常用 homesickness，也可以说 country sickness。

q37.explanationZh: at first sight“乍一看；一见（钟情）”，sight 前不加冠词。

q38.explanationZh: at the sight of“一看见……”，注意有 the。

q39.explanationZh: catch sight of“看见”，反义是 lose sight of“看不见”。

q40.explanationZh: in sight 或 within sight 都表示“在视线内；看得见”。

q41.explanationZh: in the sight of“从……的角度看来”，注意有 the。

q42.explanationZh: know sb. by sight“与某人只是面熟”，by sight 表示“凭眼见”。

q43.explanationZh: out of sight“看不见”，与 in sight 相对。

q44.explanationZh: sign up for“报名参加”，sign 本义“签名”。

q45.explanationZh: sincere“真诚的”修饰 friendship，“诚挚的友谊”。

q46.explanationZh: solid 表示“纯的；实心的”，solid silver“纯银”。

q47.explanationZh: ever since“从那以后一直”，常与现在完成时连用。

q48.explanationZh: be similar to“与……相似”，介词用 to。

q49.explanationZh: be sick (to death) of“对……厌烦（透了）”，be 后用形容词 sick。

q50.explanationZh: 情态动词 can 后用动词原形，sink 在这里是及物动词“使下沉”。

q51.explanationZh: 在人行道上骑车：on the sidewalk，sidewalk“人行道”。

q52.explanationZh: a 后接名词单数，utter a sigh“叹了口气”。

q53.explanationZh: Her 后需要名词，“潦草难认的”是她的签名 signature。

q54.explanationZh: be of great significance“有重大意义”，of 后用名词 significance。

q55.explanationZh: 向经过的船“发信号”求救，用过去式 signalled（美式拼作 signaled）。

q56.explanationZh: agree to do 后用动词原形，sign the convention“签署公约”。

q57.explanationZh: hard to do“难以……”，to 后用动词原形 simplify“简化”。

q58.explanationZh: shuttle bus“往返班车”，shuttle 作定语修饰 bus。

q59.sampleAnswer: It was many years before he gradually forgot that embarrassing episode in his life where he fainted at the sight of blood in public.
references: It was many years before he gradually forgot that embarrassing episode in his life where he fainted at the sight of blood in public.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “许多年后才……”= It was many years before...；“一看到血”= at the sight of blood；“在大庭广众之下”= in public。

q60.sampleAnswer: With the development of artificial intelligence, many traditional industries are facing significant challenges.
references: With the development of artificial intelligence, many traditional industries are facing significant challenges.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “随着……的发展”= with the development of...；“巨大的挑战”= significant challenges；“正面临”用现在进行时。

q61.sampleAnswer: It has been several decades since he last saw such a spectacular sunrise.
references: It has been several decades since he last saw such a spectacular sunrise.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: 用句型 It has been + 时间段 + since...“自从……已经有多久了”；“如此壮丽的日出”= such a spectacular sunrise。

q62.sampleAnswer: The teaching method of this online course is very similar to that of an offline course.
references: The teaching method of this online course is very similar to that of an offline course.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: be similar to“与……相似”；用 that 代替前面的 the teaching method，避免重复。

q63.sampleAnswer: Although the singer is not popular with the audience, he sticks to his own singing style.
references: Although the singer is not popular with the audience, he sticks to his own singing style.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “受……欢迎”= be popular with；“坚持”= stick to；although 与 but 不能同时使用。

q64.sampleAnswer: Since you have made up your mind to lose weight, you’d better eat less in the evening.
references: Since you have made up your mind to lose weight, you’d better eat less in the evening.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: since 表示“既然”引导原因状语从句；“下定决心”= make up one’s mind；“最好”= had better do。

q65.sampleAnswer: The students have put some flowers on either side of the corridor and hung some nice pictures on the wall.
references: The students have put some flowers on either side of the corridor and hung some nice pictures on the wall.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “在……的两边”= on either side of（side 用单数）；hang 表示“悬挂”时过去分词是 hung。

q66.sampleAnswer: The sight of the photo frequently reminds the old man of his missing daughter who was lost many years ago.
references: The sight of the photo frequently reminds the old man of his missing daughter who was lost many years ago.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: 用 the sight of the photo 作主语；“使某人想起……”= remind sb. of sth.。

q67.sampleAnswer: Many people choose to have a baby in the year of the dragon because dragon is a sign of power and status.
references: Many people choose to have a baby in the year of the dragon because dragon is a sign of power and status.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “……的标志”= a sign of...；“龙年”= the year of the dragon（手册例句作 loong）。

q68.sampleAnswer: Never just memorize single English words. Learn by heart the whole sentences and the phrases so we may know how to use the words.
references: Never just memorize single English words. Learn by heart the whole sentences and the phrases so we may know how to use the words.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: single 修饰 words 表示“单个的”；“记住”= learn by heart；“这样就可以”= so (that) we may...。
